questions.prompt: Which statement gives the core rule for “millis(), buttons, and interrupts”?
options: Peripheral and pin mappings depend on the board's MCU.
Elapsed-time checks with millis() avoid blocking in delay().
Do not assume Arduino UNO pin mappings apply to a different MCU family.
Compile and upload are separate; a successful build does not guarantee the selected port is correct.
questions.answer: Elapsed-time checks with millis() avoid blocking in delay().
questions.explanation:
Elapsed-time checks with millis() avoid blocking in delay().
Why: millis() enables non-blocking timing while loop handles other work. Keep interrupts short: set a flag for the main loop rather than delaying or doing lengthy work in an ISR.
